questions.question: When blue and orange lights, which are parallel to each other, are passed through prism then :

options.text: both emergent rays will be parallel
blue ray will bend towards the top

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**blue ray will bend more**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **splitting of white light into its individual colours** is a process known as **light dispersion**.
 
• The **spectrum **is the **collection of seven colours** that results from the division of white light.
 
• While the **velocities of the individual colours **that make up** white light** are the same in a vacuum, they differ when the light travels through a transparent material like a** glass prism**.
 
• **Different colours are deviated or bent at the prism's first face** at various angles. **Red** has a **minimum angle deviation due to maximum speed** while **violet** has a **maximum angle deviation due to minimum speed**.
 
• When **blue and orange lights, **which are parallel to each other, are passed through a prism, then the **blue ray will bend more** because **blue light has the least wavelength and minimum speed compared to orange light**, so the angle deviation or bending will be more.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **When light rays encounter an obstruction like dust, gas molecules, water vapours, etc., they deviate from their straight-line path**, and this phenomenon is known as the **scattering of light**.
 
• The **"Tyndall effect" and the "red hues of sunrise and sunset"** are just two examples of the phenomena caused by the **scattering of light**.
 
• With an** increase in wavelength, the scattering of light gets less and less**.
 
• The s**ize of the scattering particles affects the colour of the light** that is dispersed.
 
• The **Tyndall effect** is a phenomenon where light is scattered by **colloidal particles**.

questions.question: If the length of a conductor is increased five times, keeping material and thickness same, its resistance will

options.text: become five times of the original

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**become five times of the original**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **obstruction to current flow in an electrical circuit** is measured by resistance.
 
• The **SI unit of resistance **is **ohms**.
 
• The** formula for resistance of a material** is given as, R= rho {l over A}, where **rho** l, A, are the resistivity, length, and area of the cross-section of the material.
 
• When the **length of the material is increased, the resistance will also be increased** and when the **area of the cross-section of the material is increased, the resistance will be reduced**.
 
• If the **length of a conductor is increased five times**, keeping the material and thickness the same, **its resistance will become five times of the original**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrical resistivity** is a fundamental feature of a material that quantifies **how much it opposes the flow of electric current**. **Current flow is enhanced by lower resistivity**.
 
• When a **material's conductivity increases, its resistivity decreases** and vice versa since r**esistivity is the reciprocal of conductivity**.
 
• Temperature and resistivity are indirectly correlated. In other words, a**s a material's temperature rises, its resistivity will fall**.

• Mendeleev is most known for his** development of the periodic table of elements and the periodic rule**, which he** adopted in 1869**. In **St. Petersburg, Russia, on February 2, 1907, he passed away**.

questions.question: A team of 30 men is supposed to complete a work in 41 days. After 25 days, 6 more men are employed, and the work is finished one day earlier. By how many days would it have been delayed, if 6 more men were not employed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the work finished 1 day earlier than the 41-day schedule, it finished in 40 days.

The remaining work after 25 days was completed by 36 men in 15 days (40 − 25 = 15).

Total remaining work = 36 × 15 = 540 man-days.

If only the original 30 men worked, time taken for remaining work = 540 ÷ 30 = 18 days.

Initial scheduled time for the remaining work = 41 − 25 = 16 days.

Delay = Time taken by 30 men − Scheduled time = 18 − 16 = 2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of men = 30

Scheduled time to complete work = 41 days

Number of days worked by 30 men = 25 days

Extra men added after 25 days = 6

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Number of Men × Number of Days

**Calculation:**

⇒ Actual time taken to finish the work = 41 − 1 = 40 days

⇒ Days worked by the new group of men = 40 − 25 = 15 days

⇒ Total men working in the last 15 days = 30 + 6 = 36 men

⇒ Remaining work completed by 36 men = 36 × 15 = 540 units

⇒ If no extra men were added, time taken by 30 men to complete 540 units = 540 ÷ 30 = 18 days

⇒ Total days taken if no extra men were added = 25 + 18 = 43 days

⇒ Delay = Total days taken − Scheduled days

⇒ Delay = 43 − 41 = 2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

For a group of men working, the relation between Men (M), Days (D), Hours (H) and Work (W) is given by: (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Efficiency & Time Relationship

The efficiency of a worker is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work. If efficiency ratio of A and B is x:y, their time taken ratio will be y:x.

Total Work Formula

Total work can be assumed as the LCM of the days taken by individuals, and it is calculated as Total Work = Efficiency × Time Taken.

questions.question: If the 8-digit number 3 x 5479 y 4 is divisible by 88 and the 8-digit number 425139 z 2 is divisible by 9, then what is the greatest possible value of (3x + 2y - z)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divisibility of 425139z2 by 9 ⇒ Sum of digits (26 + z) is divisible by 9 ⇒ z = 1.

Divisibility of 3x5479y4 by 8 ⇒ Last 3 digits (9y4) are divisible by 8 ⇒ y can be 0, 4, or 8.

Divisibility by 11 ⇒ Difference of odd/even position sums: (x + 17) − (y + 15) = x − y + 2 must be 0 or 11.

Testing y values gives valid (x, y) pairs: (9, 0), (2, 4), and (6, 8).

Evaluate 3x + 2y − z for each: 26, 13, and 33. The maximum value is 33.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8-digit number 3x5479y4 is divisible by 88.

8-digit number 425139z2 is divisible by 9.

**Concept Used:**

Divisibility by 88 implies the number is divisible by both 8 and 11.

Divisibility by 8: The last 3 digits of the number must be divisible by 8.

Divisibility by 11: The difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Divisibility by 9: The sum of all digits must be divisible by 9.

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Find z using the divisibility rule of 9 for 425139z2.

⇒ Sum of digits = 4 + 2 + 5 + 1 + 3 + 9 + z + 2 = 26 + z

⇒ The nearest multiple of 9 greater than 26 is 27.

⇒ 26 + z = 27

⇒ z = 1

Step 2: Find y using the divisibility rule of 8 for 3x5479y4.

⇒ The last 3 digits 9y4 must be divisible by 8.

⇒ If y = 0, 904 ÷ 8 = 113 (Divisible)

⇒ If y = 4, 944 ÷ 8 = 118 (Divisible)

⇒ If y = 8, 984 ÷ 8 = 123 (Divisible)

⇒ Possible values for y are 0, 4, and 8.

Step 3: Find x using the divisibility rule of 11.

⇒ Sum of digits at odd places (from the left) = 3 + 5 + 7 + y = y + 15

⇒ Sum of digits at even places (from the left) = x + 4 + 9 + 4 = x + 17

⇒ Difference = (x + 17) − (y + 15) = x − y + 2

⇒ For divisibility by 11, (x − y + 2) must be 0 or 11.

Checking possible pairs for (x, y):

⇒ Case 1: If y = 0, x − 0 + 2 = 11 ⇒ x = 9

⇒ Case 2: If y = 4, x − 4 + 2 = 0 ⇒ x = 2

⇒ Case 3: If y = 8, x − 8 + 2 = 0 ⇒ x = 6

Step 4: Find the greatest possible value of (3x + 2y − z).

⇒ For x = 9, y = 0, z = 1 ⇒ 3(9) + 2(0) − 1 = 27 + 0 − 1 = 26

⇒ For x = 2, y = 4, z = 1 ⇒ 3(2) + 2(4) − 1 = 6 + 8 − 1 = 13

⇒ For x = 6, y = 8, z = 1 ⇒ 3(6) + 2(8) − 1 = 18 + 16 − 1 = 33

⇒ The greatest possible value obtained is 33.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is a multiple of 8.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the total sum of all its digits is completely divisible by 9.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

Divisibility of Composite Numbers

To check divisibility for a composite number like 88, simply verify divisibility for its co-prime factors, which are 8 and 11.

questions.question: The expenditure of Sudha is 125% more than her savings. If her expenditure decreases by 6% and savings increase by 26.5%, then by what percent does her income increase?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure of Sudha is 125% more than her savings.

Her expenditure decreases by 6% and savings increased by 26.5%.

**Concept Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

Let the savings be 100.

Expenditure = 100 + 125 % of Savings

⇒ Expenditure = 100 + 1.25 × (100)

⇒ Expenditure = 225

So, Income = 225 + 100

⇒ Income = 325

Now, the expenditure is decreased by 6%

⇒ New Expenditure = 94% x 225

⇒ New Expenditure = 0.94 x 225

⇒ New Expenditure = 211.5

Now, the savings is increased by 26.5%

⇒ New Savings = 126.5% x 100

⇒ New Savings= 1.265 x 100

⇒ New Savings = 126.5

So, New Income = New Expenditure + Savings

⇒ New Income = 211.5 + 126.5

⇒ New Income = 338

Also, the increase in Income = 338 - 325 = 13

So, the percent increase in Income,

⇒ (Increase in Income/ Original Income) x 100

⇒ (13/325) x 100

⇒ 4%

Hence, **Sudha's income increases by 4%**.

questions.question: The cost of 2 kg of apples and 2 kg of grapes on a day was found to be Rs. 160. After a month, the cost of 4 kg of apples and 3 kg of grapes was Rs. 300. Assuming the costs were not changed during the month, the cost of apples (per kg) will be :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost of 2 kg of apples and 2 kg of grapes on a day was found to be Rs. 160.

After a month, the cost of 4 kg of apples and 3 kg of grapes was Rs. 300.

**Concept Used:**

Let the cost of 1 kg of apples be x.

Let the cost of 1 kg of grapes be y.

**Calculations:**

Representing the given situations algebraically, we get

2x + 2y = 160 ⇒ 4x + 4y = 320 ------(1)

4x + 3y = 300 ----(2)

Now, subtracting (2) from (1), we get

4y - 3y = 320 - 300

⇒ y = 20 ---(3)

Substituting (3) in (2), we get

4x + 3(20) = 300

⇒ 4x + 60 = 300

⇒ 4x = 240

⇒ x = 60

Hence, the cost of apples (per kg) is** Rs. 60**.
